description: Embedded voucher subject mismatch (aitp/0.3). B's delegation JWS is well-formed and correctly signed, and the embedded grant voucher is genuinely A-issued (voucher.iss = A, signature valid under A's own key) — but voucher.sub is agentC, not the outer token's iss (agentB). B is presenting a voucher A issued to a different agent. RFC-AITP-0006 §4 step 4 requires voucher.sub == outer iss: the delegator-of-record must be the peer A actually granted; without this check B could delegate against any voucher it ever observed. Verifier MUST reject with DELEGATION_INVALID_VOUCHER. Manifest source: `input.issuer_manifests` carries B's (kat-keypair-002) signed Manifest, and the outer JWS verifies under the key that Manifest designates (RFC-AITP-0006 §4 step 1, RFC-AITP-0007 §1).

expected.rationale: voucher.sub (agentC) != outer token iss (agentB). The voucher itself is valid — A-issued, A-signed, unexpired, with scope ⊆ grants — so the failure isolates the delegator-of-record binding of RFC-AITP-0006 §4 step 4.
